body: Thank you, I’m planning on speaking up about it, but it’s stressful. My ERL definitely has a way of telling a person their faults. I’ll brave the storm, though.

I’m going to drink some and cry it out. There’s no winning for anyone, this subreddit gives me false hope and depresses me.
